description.value: OutSpokin' is a full-service bike shop and e-bike rental hub on Salt Spring Island, making it a key stop for cyclists exploring the island's forests, beaches, and vineyards by bike. The shop rents quality Trek e-bikes (mid-drive and rear-hub motors) as well as conventional acoustic bikes, and provides sales and servicing of brands including Rad and Trek. A touring cyclist visiting the island will find mechanical support, parts, and a gateway to curated island routes.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 77m; rack at 89m; rack at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms OutSpokin' is a bike shop and e-bike rental operation located at 102 Seaview Ave, Salt Spring Island — not Duncan as the OSM community field states; the coordinates (48.85N, 123.50W) are consistent with Salt Spring Island, so this is a metadata labelling error. The service page explicitly lists walk-in exceptions for emergency mechanicals (flat repairs, brake work, chain installs), confirming staff help with urgent issues. E-bike rentals are a primary offering (Trek mid-drive and rear-hub bikes confirmed); e-bike servicing is confirmed for Bosch, Brose, Das-kit, and Rad systems only.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: OutSpokin' is an active, full-service bike shop and e-bike rental operation on Salt Spring Island — a popular cycling destination — with confirmed mechanical support, rentals, and e-bike service. A touring cyclist would clearly benefit from this listing.
